title: Orange external recorder frame identity proof (version 2)
description: Written by the external recorder (tools/external_recorder_ipc_probe.cpp, frame_identity_proof_json) into every Cam<serial>_<stream>_summary.json as 'frame_identity_proof', one per recording session and camera stream (full-frame or crop). It certifies that every encoded video frame of the stream is bound to the recording_frame_id it was submitted with: the NVENC output timestamp of each packet is matched back to the input identity registry, and the metadata row for a frame is written only after that match. verified (and status = passed) is true iff the identity coordinator was enabled, the stream did not fail, submitted_frame_identities == returned_identity_matches == encoded_video_frames == packets_written == metadata_rows, identity_mismatches == 0, outstanding_submitted_identities == 0, and the packet write counters balance (accepted == attempts == written, rejected == failures == 0). continuity_policy encoded_subset with recording_frame_id_gaps_allowed true states the proof's scope: it certifies identity, not continuity, of the encoded frames; continuity is the stream's own contract (the full-frame ingest_authoritative stream must be dense, which Orange's gates enforce with source_frames_dropped == 0 and Palette checks on the metadata rows; a crop stream may be a policy subset). Authoritative checks: scripts/verify_external_recorder_session.py verify_frame_identity_proof.

assignment_event.description: recording_frame_id is assigned on the acquisition thread, 1-based per recording, before any consumer sees the frame

source_frames_skipped_by_policy.description: frames the recorder skipped by policy (never counted as a loss); 0 for a production full-frame stream

source_frames_dropped.description: frames the recorder dropped (a loss); Orange's gates require 0 for every stream

metadata_rows.description: rows written to the stream's metadata CSV; for a rolling session the sum of the clips' frame counts
